## Body

Companion to 2026-11-25-prd-008-receipt-only-seat-no-measurement: pij-long-vole held performance/receipt-b for pij-multiple-nightingale's spawn-count receipt. It loaded pij and builder, then waited without shell commands or peer sends. Only the close-time memory request triggered the memory index read, existing-note read and this write. No counters, CPU, RSS or launch rates were collected; no verdict or measurement claim was issued. Attribute these memory commands to closeout, not the quiet pod-up window. No review or AFTER obligation was taken on.
